item.title: What if Alabama had hired Bobby Bowden in the '80s?
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: When Ray Perkins left for the NFL, Alabama football had an opening for head coach. It was Bobby Bowden's dream job, but the Crimson Tide went in another direction. What went wrong, and what would Alabama football look like now if they hired the legendary Florida State coach? AL.com's Nick Kelly and Creg Stephenson break it down.

item.title: Paul Finebaum says Kalen DeBoer has a Nick Saban PROBLEM 😯 Which coach did Paul call 'SAD'?
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Paul Finebaum is back on "Beat Everyone!" The ESPN and SEC Network host has plenty of takes on the insane college football season so far, starting with what we've seen from Kalen DeBoer and the Alabama Crimson Tide. Fans were hot during the first half against Kentucky, but Bama blew them out in the second. Will they remain this volatile all season, and what does mean for DeBoer, who remains squarely in the shadow of his predecessor Nick Saban? Does Alabama belong in the elite category along with top teams like Texas and Ohio State? What happens if Florida State shocks them again, a year after the upset in Tallahassee? Plus, Paul plays a word association game about college football's biggest stars and shares his thoughts on the Protect College Sports Act. Also, we play "Lane or Twain?" a guessing game about Lane Kiffin and Mark Twain characters.
